message.content:
### Overall Layout & Structure  
The page has a **dark-themed, professional layout** with a top navigation bar, a three-column content section, a centered heading block, and a two-part (image + text) content card below. The design is clean but slightly dense in text-heavy areas.  


### Top Navigation Bar  
- **Branding**: Left-aligned logo “UNILOV” (gold text) with “CATERIN” (smaller, lighter text) below it.  
- **Menu Items**: Right-aligned links in gold text: *“О СОТРУДНИЧЕСТВЕ”*, *“ПРЕИМУЩЕСТВА”*, *“ТИПЫ МЕРОПРИЯТИЙ”*, *“ЗАПРОСИТЬ КП”*.  
- **Contact Info**: Far right, gold text: *“+7 (812) 919-59-11”*.  
- **Color/Contrast**: Dark background (near-black) with gold text for high contrast.  


### Three-Column Content Section (Above Centered Heading)  
Three rectangular cards (dark gray/black background) with white text, arranged horizontally. Each card contains a paragraph of Russian text:  
- **Left Card**: Discusses long-term partnerships, financial documents, and flexible payment terms.  
- **Middle Card**: Covers corporate culture, manager availability (9:00–22:00), and menu customization.  
- **Right Card**: Explains subscription pricing, fixed costs, and special conditions for event series.  
- **Spacing**: Moderate padding inside cards; consistent margin between cards.  


### Centered Heading Block  
- **Title**: *“Типы корпоративных мероприятий”* (large, elegant serif font, white + gold gradient).  
- **Subtitle**: *“Организуем любой формат — от бизнес-завтрака до гала-ужина”* (smaller, white sans-serif font).  
- **Alignment**: Centered, with ample vertical spacing from the top section.  


### Content Card (Image + Text)  
- **Image**: Left side, a high-quality photo of a formal dining table (plates, wine glasses, candles) with warm lighting.  
- **Text Section**: Right side, white text on dark background:  
  - **Heading**: *“Корпоративные праздники”* (bold, serif font).  
  - **Body**: Describes event types (New Year, company day, etc.), menu customization, and atmosphere creation.  
- **Spacing**: Image and text are balanced; text has generous line spacing for readability.  


### Visual Elements & Details  
- **Colors**: Dominant dark background (near-black) with gold accents (logo, menu, headings) and white text.  
- **Typography**: Mix of serif (headings) and sans-serif (body) fonts; consistent hierarchy.  
- **Spacing**: Adequate padding/margin in most areas, but the three-column text could feel slightly cramped.  
- **Images**: High-quality, relevant (dining setup for corporate events).  
- **Icons/Buttons**: Green WhatsApp icon (bottom right) for contact; small “N” icon (bottom left, possibly a logo or button).  


### Potential Issues  
- **Text Density**: The three-column section has long paragraphs, which may reduce scannability.  
- **Contrast**: While gold/white on dark works, some text (e.g., body in the three-column cards) could be slightly lighter for better readability.  
- **Responsiveness**: The three-column layout may not adapt well to mobile (needs testing for stacking).  


Overall, the design is professional and aligned with a corporate catering/event service, but minor tweaks to text spacing and contrast could enhance usability.
